result.summary: Found 2 minor visual issues related to inconsistent heart icon styling and missing rating info on one card.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a white background circle while the one on the pizza card below has a dark/black background circle, creating visual inconsistency between similar card components.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon button background style across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The pizza promotional card at the bottom lacks a visible restaurant name, rating, delivery time, or delivery fee text that the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it has, making the card feel incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent metadata (name, rating, delivery time/fee) beneath the pizza image to match the layout pattern used for other cards.
